fixed_findings: appointment defaults added an extra hour after minute31
late copilot brief/history could mix patient contexts
report polling job global across patients; now per patient and retains uncertain jobs
wrong-patient/late generation result now rejected
old ficha contents remained actionable on next patient loading/failure
docs tab and legal reads guarded by patient/version; programmatic tab opening also loads docs
voice synthesis missing evolution invented favorable; now unknown with labelled option
pain-map rendering was defined but never called; now follows latest note including zero
finance reads swallowed failures as empty/success, duplicate overview reads and stale filters; guarded unknown states
failed exercise-plan read marked unavailable rather than treating as no plans
cancelled invoices excluded from pending amount
Editing a voice/map-created clinical note lost body zones missing from manual select; option coverage regression added.
Pending ficha consent signature posted a name using incompatible signature field; now opens existing stored document in shared canvas and posts firma_base64 PNG.
Signature canvas relied on TouchEvent constructor existing on desktop; position handler now safely detects touch payload.

Legacy history note submission could POST twice while pending, accept incomplete acknowledgement or update another patient. Captured context, pending guard, draft preservation and explicit uncertain-write lock added. No server idempotency claimed.
Signature and voice dialogs lacked dialog naming, initial focus, Tab boundary and Escape close. Added shared existing-modal handlers and focus restoration regression.
Hidden clinical follow-up details also retain previous values; now hidden/inert with the rest of a loading/failed ficha.
Patient directory sorted appointment list separately per patient; one sorted index now retains earliest appointment per patient.

Clinic agenda mixed browser-local day/hour/week bounds with Madrid labels. Shared timezone helpers now control calendar, timeline, dashboard/directories, week GET boundaries, DST-safe day shifts and input serialization. Ambiguous/nonexistent DST input rejected before write.
Dashboard money text exceeded mobile viewport despite no root scroll overflow. Responsive min-width/grid handling and stacked metric content keep complete numbers readable.
Generated ficha overview progress, priorities, plan circuit and activity classes lacked imported styles. Added scoped existing-theme spacing and responsive hierarchy.

Consent signature retained legacy dark/green utilities and clipped controls on mobile. Added scoped white/blue theme, explicit spacing, canvas and independent long-content scrolling with accessible save action.
Appointment drawer metadata and actions lacked visual hierarchy; scoped styles and plain calendar-sync wording now match clinical theme.

remaining_findings.detail: No durable server idempotency exists for legacy history-note writes. Current view locks uncertain sends, but a reload or second process can still retry after an unknown committed response. Requires a separately validated server+schema contract; not represented as solved.
Unused renderer retained because it contains canonical source DOM markers. Astro hint only. Extending the legacy follow-up mutation contract was deliberately not attempted.

Multi-layer imported cascade has many !important declarations. Three large historical stylesheets not imported by current Layout are preserved. Structural/targeted review is not exhaustive human inspection or pixel coverage.

Undefined legacy custom properties radius-tag, color-sky-wash and color-ink-black without fallback. Later current-theme rules override affected properties; no concrete visible failure reproduced. No speculative theme change made.
DEV-only demo dates use day+1/day+2 interpolation and can become invalid at month-end; not live clinical data. Needs fixture-focused cleanup if demo continuity is required.

excluded: historical one-off frontend rewrite scripts outside src (not runtime)

methodology.logic: Source reading across initial and resumed passes, actual-handler VM regressions, isolated imports of real TS modules, patient/version races and failed/uncertain reads/writes.
methodology.css: PostCSS structural index of 22 CSS files, 19 imported by Layout, plus human targeted inspection. An indexed declaration is not a manually observed declaration or a visually verified state.
methodology.runtime: Parent coordinator owns integrated Astro check/build/UI; this reviewer ran only focused local tests, no production/network/provider sends.

dom_contract.method: Per-file unique double-quoted id/data-* attribute source strings; baseline markers retained in same source file. Counts are not DOM runtime uniqueness proof.

local_visual_verification.method: Real local built application with fixture-only HTTP routes; regression phase loads current source styles as same-origin CSS when QA_SOURCE_CSS=true. Final integrated build verification belongs to coordinator.
local_visual_verification.baseline_failure: Text Range fragments for123456,78EUR exceeded375px viewport even though ancestor clipping hid document overflow.
local_visual_verification.passed: Dashboard values120,00EUR/123456,78EUR/123.456.789,00EUR at375/768/1280; progress facts on separate lines; plan-circuit value fragments remain within cards. Entire ficha top/middle/end inspected375/1280.
local_visual_verification.signature_long_document: More than2000characters at375x667 and375x800: legal text scroll viewport133/266px with scrollHeight1112px, canvas315x160px and save317x44px accessible. White panel and blue action verified; Tab/Escape pass.
